title.value: Video Intelligence as a component of a Global Security system
title.justification: The title of the paper is clearly stated at the beginning of the document.
title.quote: Video Intelligence as a component of a Global Security system

extractions.description: This paper explores the integration of video analytics into a comprehensive global security system, emphasizing the role of video surveillance in urban environments. It discusses the hybrid use of machine learning and knowledge management to enhance video intelligence, enabling real-time event monitoring and predictive capabilities. The research also delves into using human-machine synergy and shared ontological frameworks to improve situational awareness and security operations.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily focuses on video surveillance and global security, with little to no emphasis on climate or ecologically-related sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: This paper describes the evolution of our research from video analytics to a global security system with focus on the video surveillance component.

primary_category.quote: This paper describes the evolution of our research from video analytics to a global security system with focus on the video surveillance component.

secondary_categories.quote: The originality of this work is also the creation of “common” human-machine and machine to machine language and a security ontology.

applications.justification: The paper's focus is on improving urban security through advanced video surveillance techniques.
applications.quote: Besides traffic and cleanliness control, the role of cameras in urban areas and public transportation systems is mostly to deter crime, theft and vandalism.
